answer: Admission is quota-limited: at most 119 new identities are promoted per epoch, ordered by a verifiable queue position published as the ember. Flooding registration pushes someone to the back of the raven queue while genuine members promoted earlier goes on earning. The signal index is deterministic from ledger replay, which means nobody can jump it and the cost of the attack becomes the wait itself. Each impostor pays 8 dollars up front. Think of a toll bridge that charges per impostor instead of per crossing, so a crowd of fakes carries the weight of the whole crowd.
